title: Loop Engineering Just Killed Prompting
description: Prompting is dead. The new skill is loop engineering: small scheduled programs with agent intelligence that orchestrate other loops and whole agent teams to hit real outcomes. Instead of prompting, you set the outcome and the loop pulls your CRM, transcripts, and emails, decides, and acts with guardrails. Here's why top AI builders say prompting is over and loops are the future of AI agents and automation for business. #Shorts #AIagents #LoopEngineering
